name: Row and Stake

movements.notes: drive a 4 ft (men) / 3 ft (women) stake into the ground

origin.summary: An event from the 2009 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A 500m row, a stake driven into the ground with an overhead strike, then another 500m row.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2009/4 (official CrossFit Games event, individual division confirmed), retrieved 2026-07-10
